system: Career progression logic and storage (Prog, XP, levels, prestige)
what: A persistent player record (XP, level 1-100, prestige, kills, deaths, headshots, kills per weapon) saved through KVStore with a 400 ms debounce; kills give 50 XP, or 150 inside a 5 s chain; the XP curve is 500 + 110(n-1) + 5(n-1)^2; at level 100 you can prestige back to 1. Weapon minLevel gates read Prog.level. Only the player's own kills feed it (bots have no career); the 5 s kill-chain window is reset by each kill and decays in the frame update. Per-weapon kill counts credit the weapon in hand when the kill event is processed (onKill(curW().id) at :1536; the damage event carries no weapon), so a frag-grenade kill (blast from the player's id at :1775) is counted for the held gun.
